'''Kitehawks''' were harmless [[Bird/Legends|birds]] that inhabited the jungles of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. [[Species/Legends|Species]] included the '''lesser kitehawk''' and the '''purple-winged kitehawk'''. Many [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] children kept these birds as pets.
